main_text.l: Claudiæ à Rieux, magni illius Francisci

l.i: Orporis atque animi quem Claudia Viua
armor quod lacrymas olim iustóque dolores,
go Vale, & Vita fruitor meliore, beatos
ac eadem donec qua nos mors cruda diremit,

main_text.l: dini, intimi trium Galliæ Regum à

l.i: Lle ego, cui cura, cui magna negotia Regum
Incubuere diu, tanta cui mole grauato
ssse datum (nec enim certè diuinitus ista
ot misero collata mihi memorasse pigebit)
c onus integra famaque fideque tueri,
inocua Vt Vita exemplum post fata relinquam:

page.notes: The first lines of the verse and the initial words of each line are partly damaged at the left edge and are transcribed as legible; the opening letters of several lines are uncertain. Catchword and signature read as printed at the foot.
